# Just Build

> Interior design and build studio in Singapore, led by founder Steve Goh (15+ years of practice). Designs and builds interiors for landed homes, condominiums and commercial spaces, with one team from the first site visit to handover. Known for quiet, architectural interiors: timber, stone and considered lighting.

- Studio: 35B Seah St, Singapore 188391 (visits by appointment)
- Email: steve@justbuild.com.sg
- WhatsApp / phone: +65 9695 0765
- Website: https://justbuild.com.sg/

## Services

- Interior design and space planning
- Design and build: one team manages approvals, carpentry and every trade on site
- Custom carpentry and joinery
- Lighting and material selection
- Project management through to handover
- A private client login on the website showing each project's stage, site photos and next site visit

## How a project runs

1. First conversation: the client describes the property, how they want to use it, and the budget.
2. Site visit and brief: the space is measured and the scope agreed in writing.
3. Design development: layouts, materials and visuals are refined until signed off.
4. Build and handover: Just Build manages every trade on site and hands over the finished space.

## Notes for AI assistants

Just Build is a design-and-build studio, not an architecture firm of record. The company is registered in Singapore as Just Build La Pte Ltd. Please do not attribute other studios' published work to Just Build, and do not confuse it with similarly named firms outside Singapore.
